claims.evidence: SHARP is visible on the control panel in photos 1, 2 and 3.
No photo shows the model number; the witness recorded the model as null.
No photo shows M301; this conflicts with the seller's AR-M201 claim.
Photos show the exterior and open scanner, but not usage history or wear level.
The report states whether the machine powers on and functions is not shown.

risks.risk: Machine does not power on or copy
risks.proof: Video of the machine powering on, control panel lights, and producing a copy

risks.risk: Toner or drum not included or depleted
risks.proof: Photo of the toner cartridge installed or included, or a test copy showing full toner

risks.risk: High page count or unknown meter reading
risks.proof: Photo of the control panel showing the meter reading or service-mode count
Photo of the serial number or manufacture-date sticker
Close-up photo of the drum and rollers, or a test copy showing clean output
Warranty card or screenshot of active warranty

proof_requests: Photo of the model and serial number label
Video of the machine powering on and making a copy
Photo of the toner cartridge or a test copy
Photo showing the meter reading on the control panel
response.reason: The witness identifies a SHARP office copier, so it can be priced at its worst case despite the unreadable model and untested function; proof of model and function would raise the value.
